About

Big skies, real moments

Blue Sky Photography is a professional wedding photography studio based in Ferrybank, Waterford. From castle grounds to quiet country churches, every shoot is about the same thing — keeping the moments you'll want back.

Weddings, engagements, communions and family portraits, photographed across Waterford, Kilkenny, Wexford and the whole South East — always with room for the Irish sky in the frame.

Services

What we photograph

Weddings

Full-day coverage from preparations to the last dance — relaxed, unposed, and always watching for the moment.

Engagements

Pre-wedding shoots at a location you love. A great way to get comfortable in front of the camera before the big day.

Communions & christenings

Milestone days for the whole family, photographed with patience and care — in the church, the garden, or the studio.

Family portraits

Natural family sessions outdoors or on location. The photographs your walls — and your grandchildren — will thank you for.
